_notes.logo: The game's name, one letter on each tile of the logo. Keep it 'Sparkle' unless the game has another name in your language.
_notes.board.en: The name of the scoreboard for words in English, on the Kolibri Games scoreboards.
_notes.keyboard: The letters of the on-screen keyboard, one row for each line, the way keyboards in your language have them. Only the letters a to z.
_notes.win: Said when the word is solved: the first in 1 guess, the second in 2 guesses, and so on.
_notes.help.points: {max} is the number of points for solving in one guess.

title: Sparkle
description: Guess the hidden word using letter clues. One new word a day, plus practice words.
lead: Guess the hidden word using letter clues.

daily.new: A new word every day. It counts on the scoreboard.

where.coach_counts: For coaches: Sparkle adds up points day after day, so set “Which attempt counts on the scoreboard” to “Every attempt added up”.
help.goal: Guess the hidden {length}-letter word. You have {guesses} guesses.
help.type: Type a real word and press Enter. Each letter then lights up to give you a clue:
help.hit: The letter is in the word, in this exact spot.
help.near: The letter is in the word, but in a different spot.
help.miss: The letter is not in the word (or not again).
help.points: Today's word counts on the scoreboard. You get 1 point for playing, and when you solve it, 3 points plus 1 more for every guess you didn't need. Solving in one guess earns {max} points. Points add up day after day, so playing every day matters most.
help.languages: Each language has its own daily word and its own scoreboard. Change the language in Options.
help.practice: Practice words never count, so try as many as you like.
